text_block_list.text:
One day, I called out to Wonder Acute,
who was sitting near the hollow of the great tree—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
Right now? Just doing a bit of bead weaving, a hobby of mine.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I just love meticulous work like this.
The weather's lovely today, perfect for some handicrafts."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...?
To be, or not to be—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: To search, or to give up, that is the question...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Don't you agree, Acute-san?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear me... I'm not quite sure what's going on,
but is something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed!
Just what I'd expect from Acute-san! Care to hear me out?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: As you know, tomorrow is the solo opera performance starring yours truly... However!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how much I search,
I just can't find the prop I want to use there."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... God tests me at times,
like Sarastro subjecting love to trials!"
choice_data_list: By the way, what are you looking for?
By the way, what are you looking for?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A drawstring pouch!
Well, not just any ordinary drawstring pouch, mind you!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The crown symbolizing me, the flames representing courage, and the clover signifying peace—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "And that bag adorned with pork kimchi wishing for a bountiful harvest—that is the Rhine Gold I seek!"
choice_data_list: I feel like the design might be a little too unique...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Still, I will never give up! For the word 'compromise' does not exist upon my stage!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, at this rate, until the perfect drawstring pouch
is found, the performance will have to be postponed—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Then maybe I oughta try making some?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If it's a pattern that complicated,
it'd definitely be faster to make it than search for it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Look, we've even got all the beading tools
right here ready to go.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true!? Heavens,
you are just like Papageno supporting Prince Tamino—!"
And so, Wonder Acute decided to cooperate with T.M. Opera O, but—

Finishing up the day's work and packing up to head home,
I recall the sight of Wonder Acute and the others from earlier at noon.
choice_data_list: I doubt they're still around at this point, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Acute-san~
Such wonderful dexterity~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: “So pathetic is me~, all I can do is sing a cheering song for thee~♪”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Not at all. It gives me so much energy. Thank you, for continuing to sing for us.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's an original pattern, so it's tricky, you see.
Still... just a little bit more, and--

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa, and it is complete!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravooo!
A flawless finish, Acute-san!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Acute-san!
To me, a humble servant of the God of Creation,
you have bestowed a truly warm blessing...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Though it takes the shape of a pouch, what it truly represents is her noble resolve to face trials head-on without running away!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I promise that tomorrow's performance shall be a magnificent triumph!
And that today's act shall be woven into a brand-new opera!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I'm so glad you like it that much.
I'm happy I didn't give up and saw it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure Opera O-chan is right,
and the important thing is never giving up."
choice_data_list: Make sure to take time to rest properly, too.
I could learn a thing or two from that patience.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "It's true that you need stamina to persevere and do your best... *yaaawn*."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head back to the dorms soon, then?
I have to prepare for tomorrow's performance too!

Despite T.M. Opera O's prompt,
Wonder Acute offered no reply—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "At this hour... mmn... I'm always... fast asleep..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (*inhale*... *exhale*...)

Together with T.M. Opera O,
we decided to carry the exhausted Wonder Acute
back to the dormitory on our backs.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree!
Such incredible endurance, and sheer guts!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"To reward this... I know!
I shall gift you two front-row seats
to tomorrow's opera!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The performance run time is 4 hours and 30 minutes!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Indeed, quite a masterpiece, wouldn't you say? Please, feast your eyes on this glorious collaboration of beauty between the drawstring pouch and myself!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, are you sure?
Thank you, dear. I'll be looking forward to it.

And so, during the lengthy opera viewing,
my endurance was put to the test once again.
